overview_description.description: AXON is a financial technology company building institutional-grade infrastructure to bridge traditional finance with the digital economy. The company develops a unified financial orchestration layer that connects traditional banking networks, payment corridors, stablecoins, and digital asset frameworks. Through its flagship products, AXON Pay and AXON Transfer, the platform aims to reduce cross-border settlement times from several days to under an hour.
